environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with direct TCP passthrough on port 443. No application-layer inspection. Security group allows inbound 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0. Instance runs Amazon Linux 2023 with Python 3.11, SQLite 3.41. The application is accessed directly via the NLB DNS endpoint. CloudWatch logs are enabled but no real-time alerting configured.

config.load_balancer: NLB with TCP listener on port 443, target group health check on /health
config.monitoring: CloudWatch Logs agent shipping stdout/stderr, no WAF
